identity.name: DHFR replica ensembles on one GPU: sequential versus concurrent MPS

outcome_definition.energy_series: 100 potential-energy samples per replica computed by driver; full series not serialized.

size.data_scope: PDB plus amber99sb.xml and tip3p.xml only; excludes transitive XML includes and package dependencies.
size.reason: No published peak CPU/GPU working set for sequential or eight-process concurrent ensemble; partial file sizes cannot establish size class.

scoring.objective: Minimize total_wall_s for fixed work and one GPU; report speedup and aggregate ns/day.
scoring.reason: No published fixed-work numerical energy values or acceptance tolerance. Brief predictions are hypotheses, not independently published acceptance criteria.
scoring.reference_policy: anchors.json holds one contextual approximate throughput reference with null tolerance; no numerical pass/fail from it.
scoring.correctness: Brief proposes identical outcomes for same seeds, software and GPU with deterministic forces. If not identical, fallback run-to-run variation is unquantified; no invented numerical tolerance.
scoring.constraint_tolerance_note: Integrator constraint tolerance 1e-5 is simulation configuration, not an energy scoring tolerance.

repeatability.seed_use: Both integrator random stream and initial velocities use seed0+replica_index.
repeatability.reason: No published repeat count or CUDA energy variation statistics for fixed-work ensemble. Brief reports only a small CPU smoke run, not CUDA validation.
